result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation on this food delivery app home screen.

issues.description: Restaurant names and cards in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row are cut off at the right edge (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol...'), which may look like broken clipping rather than intentional carousel scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible cards have a clear affordance (fade or peek) indicating horizontal scroll, and avoid abrupt text truncation mid-word.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon appears inconsistent: outlined dark heart on the ramen card versus a filled/dark-background heart on the pizza card, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon styling and background treatment across all restaurant cards for consistency.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar, leaving its title and details hidden below the fold.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate bottom padding so card content isn't obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar.
